parsed.notes: The filing says the Credit Agreement (Third Amended and Restated, June 29, 2026) and the DDTL Facility require a minimum Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio and a maximum Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio. The excerpt gives neither the actual values nor the required levels; it only states that the Company was in compliance as of September 30, 2026. The Applicable Rate and commitment fee also vary with the Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio, but that is a pricing grid, not a covenant test. Because no dated actual or limit figures are given, no ratio entries are reported.
